Tables of the commuting flows of the Population Census

Source: R/census-commuting-get.R
census_commuting_tables.Rd

census_commuting_tables() lists the tables of census_commuting_get() on e-Stat: one row per year and purpose, with the identifier of the table (stats_data_id) and the code and name of its item (就業・通学). It is used by the bundled pipeline.

Usage

census_commuting_tables()

Value

A tibble with columns year, purpose, stats_data_id, item_code, and item_name.

Examples

census_commuting_tables()
#> # A tibble: 2 × 5
#>    year purpose stats_data_id item_code item_name     
#>   <int> <chr>   <chr>         <chr>     <chr>         
#> 1  2020 work    0003454524    11        15歳以上就業者
#> 2  2020 school  0003454524    12        15歳以上通学者
